config.scope: all valid target shadow demo_positions; outcomes use recorded status
config.outcomes: tp/sl are resolved; open and ttl_expired remain unresolved
config.r_definition: directional exit-vs-entry divided by absolute entry-to-SL risk
config.historical_candle_rule: candle_open + 1h <= ts_open; gapped windows are unavailable
config.in_sample_rule_warning: Any candidate is selected and evaluated on the same history; it is not forward evidence.
